divergence_note: This film begins inside a contact measurement and unfolds the optical mechanism through a sample cutaway and paired spectral traces. It follows a material sample rather than a resident or a fax and uses aubergine instrument shadow, warm powder and mint optical response rather than either previous room palette.

fingerprint.palette: aubergine instrument shadow, oat powder, mint light and pale brass
fingerprint.metaphor: a touched powder yields a signature while the next handling move remains unearned

throughline.subject: The same gold-tag powder sample and mint-window contact sensor
throughline.closing_state: Contact yields a response but real application validation remains due

cinematic_contract.button: The sensor returns to the sample and the unsigned test record keeps the next move honest.

fauna_scope.reason: A laboratory sensing feasibility story has no animal subject or wildlife consequence.

documentary.viewer_question: Can a machine know what it should do with a material just by seeing it?
documentary.payoff: A contacting sensor produces information that the samples similar appearance conceals.
documentary.source_limit: Every frame is an original illustration, not observed footage. Company reports office opening; application lab remains planned. Sample stays against the sensing window. Conceptual spectra carry no numeric axes, concentration values, accuracy claim or measured result. Unknown input holds any proposed handling action until a labeled example is supplied. No deployed robot, worker replacement, medical or food safety claim. Same colored sample identification tabs and sensor survive each change of scale. Teaching a reference does not establish application performance. The illustrative handling stop is editorial caution, not a documented product safety function.
documentary.hero_image: Bands of illustrative light disappear differently inside the same pale sample.
documentary.closing_answer: The contact signal adds information; application testing still has to earn the next move.
